archetypes.name: Warrior
archetypes.identity: The party's front door: thick, loud and very hard to get past.
archetypes.want: To be the one still standing between the party and whatever is charging at it.
archetypes.cost: A head built for helmets, not hexes: spells and nerves get through where swords cannot.

archetypes.name: Mage
archetypes.identity: A library with a temper: an unshakeable mind in a very shakeable body.
archetypes.want: To understand the thing, name the thing and set the thing on fire, in that order.
archetypes.cost: Everything below the neck is on loan: one good shove and the lecture is over.

archetypes.name: Rogue
archetypes.identity: Never where the blade lands, never around when the bill arrives.
archetypes.want: To get in, get the prize and get out before anyone finishes saying "hey".
archetypes.cost: No armour and no backup plan: the one hit that does connect is the one that counts.
